name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport was a happy accident. After years managing high-end restaurants in Santiago, a chance catering gig at a local rally event ignited a passion he never knew he possessed. The blend of precision timing, demanding logistics, and the vibrant atmosphere of the paddock resonated deeply. He quickly transitioned from traditional restaurants to specializing in motorsport catering, building a reputation for impeccable service and innovative menus that catered to the unique dietary needs and preferences of drivers and crew.

At Dick Johnson Racing, Ricardo brings a meticulous approach to every meal. He understands that proper nutrition is as crucial as any technical upgrade, and he takes pride in providing fuel that powers peak performance. He's known for his insistence on fresh, locally-sourced ingredients and his ability to create customized meal plans that accommodate even the most restrictive diets. His demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to excellence – he believes that even the smallest detail can make a difference in the pursuit of victory.

Ricardo's distinctive touch lies in his ability to blend traditional Chilean flavors with modern nutritional science. He's constantly experimenting with new recipes and techniques, always striving to create meals that are both delicious and performance-enhancing. He sees his role not just as a caterer, but as an integral part of the team, contributing to their overall success through his culinary expertise.

physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using only imported Chilean sea salt.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and dietary notes.
Has a habit of tasting every dish multiple times, even if he prepared it himself.
